testCollection.note: Collected the entire existing Playwright suite after fixing Node import compatibility. Optional static suites require their dedicated outputs flag.

integratedSourceGates.provenance: Executed sequentially by ui_quality after the final game assistance fix; this summary references that receipt without claiming another run.

rendering.note: Raw bridge hashes differ because a hashed bootstrap import follows the bundle graph. The normalized comparison replaces exactly that one from"./index-HASH.js" specifier; rendering scene/bloom/Three.js hashes are compared without normalization.

brandLifecycleRepair: The worker bridge intentionally gained synchronous pending-startup termination. Rendering scene, bloom and Three.js chunks remain byte-identical; root separately reports15 other brand source files unchanged. This report does not claim the bridge source is unchanged.

preservedCheckpoints.note: Earlier40-case static acceptance is a checkpoint, not the final release. Parent viewport review subsequently found header clipping; final source includes the compact header repair, worker bridge lifecycle repair and game assistance-evidence fix. No after2/after3 static builds were produced.

preservedFailures.cause: New CacheStorage fixture returned one consumed Response repeatedly; corrected fixture to clone responses like the browser Cache API. No production cache change needed.
New test expected 75%; UI correctly formats 75.0%. Assertion now targets the precise correct cell.

Root full-suite collection found unguarded import.meta.env in the new deployment helper; guarded Node imports, added a plain-Node subprocess regression and recollected the full suite successfully. That guard emitted identical bundles at the pre-semantic checkpoint.

The initial global comparison incorrectly required bridge bytes to match even when hashed bootstrap import names changed. Final evidence preserves raw bridge hashes and narrowly normalizes just that one import; actual rendering chunks are compared without normalization.

outputIsolation: This agent built only dist-static-vercel and dist-static-pages; root owns the subsequent production dist build.

vercelPermissionsPolicy.scope: The camera/microphone/geolocation/gyroscope restriction was restored after static acceptance. Only staged configuration is checked; local directory-server tests do not claim actual Vercel response-header verification. Compiled assets are unchanged.

phpPackagingRetry.scope: A bounded Windows-only retry was added to the same atomic directory rename. Root recreated and byte-checked the fresh hosting package; this helper change does not alter compiled web assets.

viteDevelopmentFileBoundary.scope: After static acceptance, Vite development-only fs.deny gained private PHP configuration/storage and generated hosting paths while retaining installed Vite defaults. A fresh nonsecret canary verifies the HTTP boundary; the public course catalog/module and isolated API proxy remain available. No actual private file was requested. Static acceptance predates this dev-only configuration change; root separately verifies final production asset identity.

limitations: No external Vercel or GitHub Pages deployment performed.
No hosted Actions run, custom-domain DNS or TLS verified.
Playwright WebKit is not a real iOS hardware acceptance test.
Browser persistence/offline availability remains subject to storage permissions and eviction.
Static builds intentionally cannot authenticate, sync, validate ranked scores or host human rooms.
Project paths share browser-origin storage and are not a personal-data security boundary.
